title: Friday morning, what shipped overnight
dek: May 2026: payment receipts and a clearer approval flow.
body: In May 2026, the agent-payments work reached a public milestone. The **[/money](/money)** surface presented payment receipts and approval state in a readable, auditable format. The approval path was tightened so asynchronous requests reached a terminal state reliably. The public schema kept sensitive payment details out of blocks and separated receipt metadata from private handling. The release established a clearer boundary for buyer-authorized payment actions and created a foundation for future receipt improvements.
